name: WNBA_R3A5B_QUALITY_ADJUSTED_FORM_OOS_ABLATION_CONTRACT_V1
purpose: Measure whether the preregistered quality-adjusted recent-form family adds reproducible rolling-origin OOS probability information conditional on the frozen R2 selected side. No Elite threshold or side-selection policy is searched in this gate.

frozen_inputs.required_join: Exact one-to-one season + gameId join across all 1269 rows. No post-result row dropping.

population.rolling_origin_rule: For target season Y, fit only seasons strictly less than Y.

training_only_preprocessing.feature_standardization: Within each rolling-origin fold, subtract training-fold mean and divide by training-fold population standard deviation for each of the six features. Target season never contributes to preprocessing.
training_only_preprocessing.zero_variance_rule: If training population SD <= 1e-12, set that feature z-value to zero in train and target and report the event.

reference_model.algorithm: Exact deterministic 1D Platt semantics frozen in R2 and reverified in R3A4.

augmented_model.form: sigmoid(intercept + beta_base*base_logit + sum(beta_j*z_j)) for the six frozen quality-form features.
augmented_model.optimizer: Same deterministic multivariate Newton/IRLS generalization used in frozen R3A4.
augmented_model.penalty: Intercept unpenalized; beta_base and all six feature slopes use identical L2 ridge lambda.
augmented_model.singular_hessian_rule: Operational fail; no alternate optimizer after target outcomes.

metrics.selected_side_accuracy: descriptive and invariant because side switching is disabled

reported: 95 percent percentile CI for augmented-minus-reference Brier
95 percent percentile CI for augmented-minus-reference log loss

frozen_incremental_value_gate.primary: At least one pooled proper score has a directional 95 percent paired-bootstrap upper bound below 0 for augmented-minus-reference Brier OR log loss.
frozen_incremental_value_gate.season_breadth: The qualifying proper score improves by point estimate in at least 3 of 5 target seasons.
